evidence: Modifies `src/wallet/test/coinselection_tests.cpp` to correctly test SRD coin selection weight-based tie-breaking.
rationale: Ensures wallet coin selection unit tests properly test weight-based eviction tie-breaking. As noted in the description, reversing the tie-breaking logic from #33223 still passed all unit and functional tests because the test passed `utxo_pool` instead of `mixed_weight_pool` and used a weight threshold that never triggered eviction.
